home.seoIntroHeading: Bo.TiC, a gastronomic restaurant in Corçà, at the heart of Empordà.
home.seoIntroBody: Ingredient-led, seasonal cuisine with roots, technique and a contemporary outlook.
home.featRestaurantTitle: A space designed for the table
home.featRestaurantBody: An 18th-century farmhouse in the heart of Corçà. Stone, wood and natural light in service of gastronomy.
home.featGastroTitle: The product is the first decision
home.featGastroBody: Bo.TiC's cuisine is born from the Empordà. Season, technique and memory in every dish.
home.featExpTitle: A pace of its own. A complete story.
home.featExpBody: Tasting menu, dining room and hospitality. An experience that begins with the first amuse-bouche and doesn't end until farewell.

restaurant.heroImgAlt: Architectural interior of Bo.TiC restaurant in Corçà, stone and wood
restaurant.heroHeading: A unique space in the heart of the Empordà
restaurant.heroSub: Bo.TiC occupies a restored former workshop in Corçà, where architecture, light and gastronomy build a singular experience.
restaurant.originHeading: A former carriage workshop turned restaurant
restaurant.originP1: Bo.TiC is located in Corçà, an unbeatable spot in the heart of the Baix Empordà.
restaurant.originP2: The restaurant occupies a former carriage workshop over 110 years old, restored in 2017 to recover its architectural value and become the space it is today.
restaurant.originP3: Stone, wood, metal and light combine to create a space designed entirely for the gastronomic experience.
restaurant.archHeading: A space lived through the senses
restaurant.archRoom1Body: Exposed stone walls, original wooden beams and light entering through rounded arch windows. The interior design is understated so the dishes and the people take centre stage.
restaurant.archRoom1ImgAlt: Dining room of Bo.TiC restaurant with stone walls and natural light
restaurant.archRoom2Body: At the chef's table, the kitchen is experienced up close. An intimate setting to share the rhythm of service, the precision of every gesture and a dialogue with the team.
restaurant.archRoom2ImgAlt: Bo.TiC chef's table beside the kitchen
restaurant.archRoom3Body: Stone, wood and metal coexist in a wine cellar and spaces designed to age well, with time as the only ornament.
restaurant.archRoom3ImgAlt: Wine cellar with natural materials at Bo.TiC restaurant
restaurant.archRoom4Body: Kitchen, dining room and hospitality move to the same rhythm. Every gesture is designed so the space recedes and the guest can experience the whole journey.
restaurant.archRoom4ImgAlt: Albert Sastregener working in the kitchen at Bo.TiC restaurant

restaurant.teamSub: Kitchen, dining room and hospitality share the same way of understanding Bo.TiC.
restaurant.kitchenBody: Refined technique, precise coordination and produce that comes first: this is how the Bo.TiC kitchen team works every service.
restaurant.kitchenImgAlt: Albert Sastregener in the kitchen of Bo.TiC restaurant
restaurant.salaBody: Cristina Torrent is the director and head of the dining room, working alongside Aga Ogórek and Cristóbal as sommeliers. Together with the rest of the team, they cover service across the restaurant's two dining rooms, a total of seven people.

restaurant.finalHeading: A table, a rhythm, a complete experience

gastronomia.heroHeading: The product is the first decision
gastronomia.heroSub: Everything that arrives in the kitchen carries an address, a farmer and a season.
gastronomia.producteP1: We work with local producers with whom we have built a relationship of trust over the years. We know where every ingredient comes from, how it was raised or grown, and at what point in its cycle it is at its best.
gastronomia.producteP2: The season is not a trend: it is a way of understanding cuisine. The menu changes when what the land offers changes, not when some external expert's calendar changes.
gastronomia.producteP3: Market garden vegetables, fish from the Palamós fish market, native-breed meats, autumn mushrooms, arbequina olive oil from the Alt Empordà. Ingredients that need no explanation because they speak for themselves.
gastronomia.producteImgAlt: Seasonal produce at Bo.TiC restaurant in the Empordà
gastronomia.territorP1: The Empordà is our larder and our horizon. A territory of exceptional agri-food richness: irrigated vegetables, vineyards, olive groves, artisanal fishing, mushrooms and a culinary tradition accumulating centuries of know-how.
gastronomia.territorP2: Bo.TiC could not exist anywhere else. Its cuisine is a child of this landscape, this climate and these people. The restaurant is, ultimately, a way of paying homage to all of this.
gastronomia.tecnicaP1: Technique is not an end in itself. At Bo.TiC, technique is a means: a way of expressing better what the product already carries within it. Modern cuisine has given us extraordinary tools, but the only criterion for using them is whether or not they improve what we want to put on the plate.
gastronomia.tecnicaP2: There is no gratuitous technical ostentation. Every preparation must make sense in the context of the menu, the season and the main ingredient. Apparent simplicity is, almost always, the most demanding technical resolution.
gastronomia.ctaBody: Bo.TiC's tasting menu is the format that best expresses our cuisine. Book in advance.

menus.heroTitle: Three ways to enter Bo.TiC's gastronomic universe.
menus.esenciaNote: Available at lunch from Wednesday to Friday, except public holidays and eves.
menus.seasonNote: The menu may vary according to season and product availability.
menus.wineLead: We have an extensive wine list with over 900 references from different countries.
menus.wineBody1: Spain, Portugal, France, Italy, Germany, Austria, Greece, Lebanon, Moldova, Australia, South Africa, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Bolivia, United States and New Zealand — always searching for the finest wines.
menus.wineBody2: A versatile cellar with numerous appellations and references from every corner of the world, each with a strong character of its own.
menus.info02: Menus are served to the whole table.
menus.info03: Menus may be modified according to market availability or new dishes, while always respecting the menu structure.
menus.faqSubtitle: A few details to help you enjoy the experience with peace of mind.
menus.faqA1: No, the menus do not include drinks. Drinks and wine pairings can be chosen separately according to the experience desired.
menus.faqQ2: Are the menus served to the whole table?
menus.faqA2: Yes, menus are served to the whole table to maintain the rhythm and coherence of the gastronomic experience.
menus.faqA3: Yes, the proposal may vary according to season, market availability or restaurant novelties, always respecting the menu structure.
menus.faqA4: Yes, we recommend booking in advance to ensure availability and prepare the experience with the utmost care.
menus.faqA5: Bo.TiC is located in Corçà, in the Empordà, in a restored farmhouse where territory, chef's cuisine and hospitality come together.
menus.faqQ6: Is there a wine pairing option?
menus.faqA6: The experience can be accompanied by a selection of wines from our cellar, with over 900 references from different countries.
menus.faqQ7: What is the difference between the menus?
menus.faqA7: Each menu offers a different way to approach Bo.TiC's gastronomic universe: from a more essential experience to a more complete and gastronomic proposal.
menus.ctaBody: Menus may vary according to season, product and availability.

experiencia.heroHeading: A pace of its own. A complete story.
experiencia.ritmeP1: A table at Bo.TiC follows its own rhythm. There is no rush. The tasting menu is conceived as a story that begins, establishes itself, surprises and concludes.
experiencia.ritmeP2: The front-of-house team accompanies this process with naturalness and knowledge, without excessive protocol or unnecessary distance. Every dish arrives when it should. Every explanation is given when it adds value.
experiencia.ritmeP3: The duration of a service at Bo.TiC is variable. We let the experience take the time it needs.
experiencia.salaImgAlt: Bo.TiC dining room prepared for service
experiencia.menuHeading: A structure conceived as a story
experiencia.moment01Text: The first steps of the menu: amuse-bouches that set the tone, the territory and the season. An introduction that opens the appetite and the conversation.
experiencia.moment02Text: The central dishes of the menu, where the kitchen speaks with greater depth. Main produce, technique and gastronomic memory at their fullest expression.
experiencia.moment03Text: A conclusion that is not a simple ending. Bo.TiC's desserts follow the same logic of territory and season as the rest of the menu.
experiencia.moment03ImgAlt: Strawberry dessert from Bo.TiC's tasting menu
experiencia.moment04Text: Small preparations that extend the pleasure. A final memory of the menu to take home.
experiencia.menuNote: The menu may vary according to season and product availability.
experiencia.equipP1: Albert Sastregener has led the kitchen since the restaurant's founding. Alongside him, a small team that understands that hospitality is as important as what arrives on the plate.
experiencia.equipP2: The dining room is led by a team with deep knowledge of the menu, the wines and the producers. The complicity between kitchen and dining room is felt in every service.
experiencia.equipP3: The small team size is not a limitation: it is a decision. It allows absolute control of the experience and a more direct and genuine relationship with each guest.
experiencia.vinsHeading: A wine selection designed to accompany
experiencia.vinsP1: Bo.TiC's cellar is a personal selection of wines from the Empordà and the finest Catalan appellations, complemented by international references of interest.
experiencia.vinsP2: We also offer a wine pairing conceived specifically to accompany the tasting menu of each season.
experiencia.ctaBody: Each service is a limited space. Don't leave it to the last moment.
